result:
I’d increase people’s ability to genuinely understand one another’s experiences and suffering.

Many of the world’s biggest problems—conflict, inequality, cruelty, neglect—become easier to sustain when other people feel abstract, distant, or unreal. If empathy were deeper and more immediate, more people would act to reduce harm, listen before judging, and build systems that are kinder and fairer.
